trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Disney World, Orlando, Florida
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

hotel.name: Ramada by Wyndham Kissimmee Gateway - Free Theme Park Shuttle
hotel.location: 7470 W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy, Kissimmee, US (28.3314,-81.5863)

day_by_day.morning: N/A - Late arrival day
day_by_day.afternoon: N/A - Late arrival day
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 22:30 via United Airlines. Take the Magical Express or a budget rideshare (Lyft/Uber ~$25-35) to Ramada by Wyndham Kissimmee Gateway. Check in, unpack, and review your Disney World park tickets and free shuttle schedule posted at the front desk. Pick up any resort maps or discount coupon books available in the lobby.

meals.breakfast: N/A
meals.lunch: N/A
meals.dinner: Grab a quick late-night bite at the hotel vending machines or a nearby 24-hour Walmart Neighborhood Market (~1 mile away) to stock up on snacks, water bottles, and breakfast items for the week — a huge budget saver.

day_by_day.notes: Priority on arrival night: purchase or confirm Disney park tickets online before sleeping to avoid long lines. Download the My Disney Experience app. Set an early alarm for Day 2. Stock your mini-fridge with groceries to cut daily food costs significantly.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up early (6:30 AM) and take the FREE hotel shuttle to Magic Kingdom — aim to arrive at park opening (typically 9:00 AM). Use Early Entry if eligible. Head straight to Tomorrowland and Fantasyland to hit Space Mountain, Seven Dwarfs Mine Train, and Peter Pan's Flight before crowds build. Use the My Disney Experience app to grab Lightning Lane selections strategically.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Liberty Square and Adventureland — ride Pirates of the Caribbean, Haunted Mansion, and Big Thunder Mountain Railroad. Take a midday break during peak heat (1–3 PM) by enjoying the indoor shows like the Hall of Presidents or catching the Festival of Fantasy Parade. Refill your reusable water bottle at any quick-service location for free.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the iconic Happily Ever After fireworks show (check app for exact time, usually 9:00 PM). Grab a spot on Main Street U.S.A. 30 minutes early for the best view. Take the hotel shuttle back after the show.

meals.breakfast: Eat breakfast at the hotel or from groceries purchased last night — granola bars, fruit, and juice to save money.
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square — try the Lobster Roll or Fried Fish Platter (~$12-15). Split a meal if portions are large.
meals.dinner: Cosmic Ray's Starlight Café in Tomorrowland — one of Magic Kingdom's most affordable quick-service spots. Burgers and chicken meals ~$12-14. Share sides to cut costs.

day_by_day.notes: Wear comfortable shoes and bring a small backpack with sunscreen, a portable fan, and a refillable water bottle. Magic Kingdom is the most iconic park — prioritize it early in the trip when energy is highest. Check the app for any special June seasonal events.

day_by_day.morning: Take the free hotel shuttle to EPCOT, arriving at rope drop (~9:00 AM). Head immediately to World Discovery to ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (virtual queue — join as soon as the park opens via the app). Then ride Test Track and Mission: SPACE before lines grow.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore World Showcase starting at 11:00 AM — walk the 11 country pavilions around the lagoon. Enjoy free entertainment, cultural exhibits, and street performers. Visit the Mexico Pavilion (ride Gran Fiesta Tour — short wait, air-conditioned). Browse the Norway, Japan, and France pavilions. Look for EPCOT International Food & Wine Festival booths if running (typically starts in July, but check for early June events).
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT Forever or Harmonious nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon (check app for timing). Find a spot near the International Gateway for a great view. Shuttle back to hotel afterward.

meals.breakfast: Hotel room breakfast — instant oatmeal, fruit, and coffee from groceries.
meals.lunch: Sunshine Seasons in The Land Pavilion — one of EPCOT's best budget quick-service spots. Rotisserie chicken, sandwiches, and salads ~$11-14.
meals.dinner: World Showcase food booths or Katsura Grill in the Japan Pavilion — teriyaki chicken bowl ~$13. Alternatively, share a large meal from the France or Morocco pavilion food windows.

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is very walkable but large — wear comfortable shoes. The World Showcase doesn't open until 11:00 AM, so use the morning for rides in World Discovery and World Nature. Stay hydrated — June in Florida is hot and humid.

day_by_day.morning: Take the hotel shuttle to Hollywood Studios, arriving at rope drop. Make a beeline for Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge — ride Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run first (shorter wait than Rise of the Resistance). Then immediately join the virtual queue or Individual Lightning Lane for Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance — the most immersive ride in all of Disney World.
day_by_day.afternoon: Ride Slinky Dog Dash and Toy Story Mania in Toy Story Land (great for all ages). Catch the Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular show (free with park admission, check schedule). Visit the Animation Courtyard and catch Disney Junior Play & Dance if traveling with young kids.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the Fantasmic! nighttime show (check app for showtimes — usually 8:00 or 9:30 PM). Arrive 45 minutes early for good seating. This is a must-see spectacular with minimal extra cost. Shuttle back to hotel after the show.

meals.breakfast: Hotel room breakfast to save money.
meals.lunch: Woody's Lunch Box in Toy Story Land — one of the most affordable and beloved quick-service spots. Grilled cheese, BBQ brisket melts, and totchos ~$10-13.
meals.dinner: Backlot Express near Echo Lake — burgers, chicken strips, and sandwiches ~$11-14. Sit in the air-conditioned interior to cool down before the evening show.

day_by_day.notes: Hollywood Studios has the most in-demand rides at Disney World — arrive early and use the app aggressively. Fantasmic! is free with park admission and absolutely worth staying for. This is a high-energy day, so pace yourself in the afternoon heat.

day_by_day.morning: Take the hotel shuttle to Disney's Animal Kingdom, arriving at rope drop. Head directly to Pandora – The World of Avatar and ride Avatar Flight of Passage (the park's most popular ride — waits can exceed 2 hours by mid-morning). Then ride Na'vi River Journey in the same land.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Africa and ride Kilimanjaro Safaris — best in the morning or late afternoon when animals are most active. Visit the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail (free walking trail with gorillas, hippos, and exotic birds). Catch the Festival of the Lion King show in Africa — a spectacular live performance included with park admission.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the Rivers of Light nighttime show or Tree of Life Awakenings (the Tree of Life lights up with animal projections after dark — magical and free with admission). Animal Kingdom closes earlier than other parks (~8–9 PM), so plan accordingly. Head back to the hotel and rest — you've earned it!

meals.breakfast: Hotel room breakfast.
meals.lunch: Flame Tree Barbecue in Discovery Island — one of Disney World's best quick-service meals. Ribs, pulled pork, and chicken with beautiful outdoor waterfront seating ~$13-16. Share a platter to save.
meals.dinner: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora — customizable bowls with rice, noodles, or salad base with protein ~$13-15. Healthy, filling, and one of the best quick-service values in all of Disney World.

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom is best experienced in the morning and late afternoon — midday heat is intense and animals retreat to shade. The park is also the most nature-focused, so take time to enjoy the walking trails and live entertainment, which are all included with admission.

day_by_day.morning: Take a well-deserved rest morning — sleep in until 8:00–9:00 AM. Use the hotel pool to cool off and relax. This is a great day to do laundry if needed, recharge devices, and review any missed experiences from earlier in the week. Check the My Disney Experience app for any park reservations or Lightning Lane availability.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit Disney Springs (FREE admission — no park ticket required). Explore the massive outdoor shopping, dining, and entertainment complex. Browse World of Disney (the largest Disney merchandise store in the world), visit the LEGO Store, and enjoy free street entertainment and live music. Walk along the waterfront and enjoy the atmosphere.
day_by_day.evening: Catch a movie at the AMC Disney Springs 24 theater (~$15-18 per ticket) or enjoy free live music at the Marketplace Stage. Have dinner at one of Disney Springs' more affordable options before heading back to the hotel via the free Disney Springs shuttle.

meals.breakfast: Hotel room breakfast — use remaining groceries from the week.
meals.lunch: Chicken Guy! at Disney Springs — Guy Fieri's chicken tender restaurant with 22 dipping sauces. Tenders and fries ~$12-15. Great value and very popular.
meals.dinner: D-Luxe Burger at Disney Springs — gourmet burgers with creative toppings ~$13-16. Alternatively, grab food from the Marketplace food trucks for ~$10-12 per person.

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is completely free to enter and a great way to experience Disney magic without using a park ticket. It's also one of the best spots for souvenir shopping — prices are the same as in the parks but the atmosphere is more relaxed. The free shuttle from the hotel makes this an easy, low-cost day.

day_by_day.morning: Use this final day to revisit your favorite park or catch any missed experiences. If you have a park-hopper ticket, start at Magic Kingdom for a final Main Street stroll and any rides with shorter Sunday morning waits. Alternatively, revisit EPCOT's World Showcase for any pavilions you missed. Pick up last-minute souvenirs — look for discounted items at the end of your trip.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the hotel by 2:00–3:00 PM to pack, check out (or store luggage at the front desk), and freshen up. Take one last dip in the hotel pool if time allows. Confirm your departure transportation — rideshare to Orlando International Airport is ~$25-35 and takes about 30-40 minutes depending on traffic.
day_by_day.evening: Head to Orlando International Airport with plenty of time before your departure flight. Enjoy a final Florida meal at the airport or grab snacks from a convenience store near the hotel before leaving.

meals.breakfast: Final hotel room breakfast — finish any remaining groceries to avoid waste.
meals.lunch: If in a park: Casey's Corner at Magic Kingdom (hot dogs and corn dog nuggets ~$9-12) or a quick-service spot of your choice. If at the hotel: nearby Denny's or IHOP on US-192 for a classic American breakfast/lunch combo (~$10-14 per person).
meals.dinner: Airport dining or a final meal at a budget-friendly restaurant near the hotel such as Olive Garden, Applebee's, or Perkins on US-192 — all within 1-2 miles of the Ramada.

day_by_day.notes: Final day tips: Check the My Disney Experience app for any last-minute Lightning Lane availability. Return any rented strollers or equipment. Take photos on Main Street U.S.A. for a classic Disney farewell. Budget recap: By using the free hotel shuttle daily, eating hotel breakfasts, sharing meals, and refilling water bottles, a family of 4 can save $200-400+ over the week compared to buying everything in-park.

day_by_day.morning: N/A – Flight arrives at 22:30. No morning activities scheduled.
day_by_day.afternoon: N/A – In transit. No afternoon activities scheduled.
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 22:30 on Flight UA. Collect luggage, arrange ground transportation or rideshare to Ramada by Wyndham Kissimmee Gateway (~25–30 min drive). Check in, unpack, and review the week's park schedule. Pick up any snacks from the hotel vending area or a nearby 24-hour Walgreens on W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy.

meals.breakfast: On the plane or at the airport before departure.
meals.lunch: On the plane or at the airport.
meals.dinner: Late-night snack from hotel vending or a quick stop at a nearby 24-hour fast-food drive-through (McDonald's or Taco Bell on US-192) on the way from the airport.

day_by_day.notes: Keep Day 1 light — rest is essential after a late arrival. Confirm the hotel's free theme park shuttle schedule at check-in. Purchase Disney park tickets online tonight if not already done to save time. Set an early alarm for Day 2.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park – Arrive at rope drop (park opens ~9:00 AM; take the hotel's free shuttle departing ~7:30–8:00 AM). Head straight to Tomorrowland for Space Mountain and Buzz Lightyear's Space Ranger Spin before crowds build. Then hit Fantasyland for Seven Dwarfs Mine Train (use Lightning Lane if available) and Peter Pan's Flight.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring Magic Kingdom. Visit Adventureland for Pirates of the Caribbean and the Jungle Cruise. Enjoy Liberty Square's Haunted Mansion. Take a mid-afternoon break at the hotel (use the shuttle) if energy dips — especially important with kids — then return for the evening.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Magic Kingdom for the evening spectacular. Watch the Main Street Electrical Parade and the Happily Ever After fireworks show over Cinderella Castle (typically ~9:00 PM). Catch the shuttle back to the hotel afterward.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick continental breakfast at the hotel or pack granola bars/fruit for the shuttle ride to maximize park time.
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square – counter-service seafood and sandwiches at a mid-range price (~$12–$16 per person). Great air-conditioned spot.
meals.dinner: The Plaza Restaurant on Main Street U.S.A. – a table-service classic with burgers, sandwiches, and salads (~$18–$28 per person). Make an advance dining reservation (ADR) via the My Disney Experience app.

day_by_day.notes: Download the My Disney Experience app and enable Lightning Lane selections. Wear comfortable shoes and bring sunscreen, hats, and a refillable water bottle. June in Orlando is hot and humid (~90°F/32°C) with afternoon thunderstorms possible — pack a small poncho.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour – Take the hotel shuttle to EPCOT (arrive by 9:00 AM). Start in Future World/World Discovery with Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind and Test Track. Then make your way to the World Showcase as it opens (~11:00 AM).
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon touring the 11 country pavilions around World Showcase Lagoon. Sample authentic cuisines and snacks from Mexico (churros, tacos), Japan (sushi, mochi), France (crêpes), and Morocco (hummus, flatbread). Ride Frozen Ever After in Norway and Remy's Ratatouille Adventure in France. Browse unique merchandise and cultural exhibits.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT's Luminous: The Symphony of Us nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon (~9:00 PM). Grab a final dessert or drink from a pavilion kiosk before heading back on the hotel shuttle.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast or a quick stop at a nearby Dunkin' or Starbucks on W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy before the shuttle.
meals.lunch: Graze through World Showcase pavilion quick-service kiosks — budget ~$20–$30 per person for a fun food-tour-style lunch across 3–4 countries.
meals.dinner: Coral Reef Restaurant at EPCOT's The Seas pavilion – table-service dining with an aquarium view, serving seafood and steaks (~$25–$40 per person). Book an ADR in advance.

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is very walkable but large — comfortable footwear is a must. The World Showcase is ideal for older kids and adults. Younger children will love Frozen Ever After and the interactive Kim Possible World Showcase Adventure. Stay hydrated in the afternoon heat.

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios – Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure. Take the hotel shuttle for rope drop (~9:00 AM). Head immediately to Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge at Batuu. Book a time slot for Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run first thing. If budget allows, reserve Savi's Workshop (lightsaber building, ~$249.99) or the Droid Depot (~$119.99) — book these well in advance online.
day_by_day.afternoon: Ride Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance (one of Disney's most immersive attractions — use Lightning Lane). Explore the rest of Hollywood Studios: Toy Story Land (Slinky Dog Dash, Alien Swirling Saucers), Rock 'n' Roller Coaster, and The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror. Catch the Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular show.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the Fantasmic! nighttime show at the Hollywood Hills Amphitheater (~8:00 or 9:00 PM, check schedule). This 30-minute spectacular features Mickey Mouse, Disney villains, and stunning water/fire effects. Return to hotel via shuttle.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick bite at the hotel or pick up a pastry at Ronto Roasters in Galaxy's Edge (Ronto Morning Wraps are a fan favorite).
meals.lunch: Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo in Galaxy's Edge – themed counter-service with unique dishes like Smoked Kaadu Ribs and Fried Endorian Tip-Yip (~$15–$20 per person). Fully immersive Star Wars experience.
meals.dinner: 50's Prime Time Café – a fun, nostalgic table-service diner with comfort food classics like pot roast and fried chicken (~$18–$28 per person). Great for families. Book an ADR.

day_by_day.notes: Hollywood Studios is one of the busiest parks — arrive at rope drop. Lightning Lane Multi Pass is highly recommended for Rise of the Resistance. Savi's Workshop requires advance reservations and is a splurge but a once-in-a-lifetime experience for Star Wars fans.

day_by_day.morning: Animal Kingdom – Kilimanjaro Safari & Avatar Flight of Passage. Take the hotel shuttle for rope drop (~8:00 AM — Animal Kingdom opens early). Go directly to Pandora – The World of Avatar and ride Avatar: Flight of Passage first (longest lines of the day form quickly). Then ride Na'vi River Journey.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to Africa for the Kilimanjaro Safari (best wildlife activity in late morning before midday heat). Spot lions, elephants, giraffes, rhinos, and hippos in a realistic savanna setting. Explore the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail on foot. Visit Asia for Expedition Everest and Kali River Rapids (you will get wet — great for a hot afternoon). Catch the Festival of the Lion King show in Africa.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy the Tree of Life Awakenings projection show at dusk — the Tree of Life comes alive with animal stories projected onto its surface. Dine at the park before heading back on the hotel shuttle.

meals.breakfast: Grab a light breakfast at the hotel before the early shuttle — Animal Kingdom's early opening rewards early risers.
meals.lunch: Flame Tree Barbecue in Discovery Island – one of Disney's best counter-service spots with smoked ribs, pulled pork, and chicken (~$14–$18 per person). Beautiful outdoor waterfront seating.
meals.dinner: Yak & Yeti Restaurant in Asia – table-service pan-Asian cuisine including Mandarin chicken, pot stickers, and ahi tuna (~$20–$35 per person). Book an ADR. Alternatively, use the Yak & Yeti Local Food Cafes counter-service for a budget-friendly option.

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom is best experienced in the morning when animals are most active on the safari. Bring a change of shirt if riding Kali River Rapids. The park often closes earlier than other parks (~6:00–8:00 PM), so plan accordingly.

day_by_day.morning: Rest & Hotel Pool Morning – After five busy park days, take a relaxed morning at the Ramada's pool. Sleep in, enjoy a leisurely breakfast, and recharge. This is especially important for families with young children. Use the time to do laundry, repack, or browse Disney Springs shopping online.
day_by_day.afternoon: Disney Springs Family Entertainment Day – Take the hotel shuttle or a short rideshare to Disney Springs (free admission, no park ticket required). Explore the four neighborhoods: The Landing, Marketplace, Town Center, and West Side. Watch free street performers and live entertainment. Browse unique shops like World of Disney (the largest Disney merchandise store). Visit LEGO Store, NBA Experience, or Splitsville Luxury Lanes (bowling, ~$15–$20/person).
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy dinner and evening entertainment at Disney Springs. Catch a movie at the AMC Disney Springs 24 theater or enjoy live music at one of the waterfront venues. Browse the illuminated waterfront before heading back to the hotel.

meals.breakfast: Relaxed hotel breakfast or a nearby IHOP/Denny's on US-192 for a classic American sit-down breakfast (~$10–$15 per person).
meals.lunch: D-Luxe Burger at Disney Springs – gourmet burgers with creative toppings in a fun, casual setting (~$12–$16 per person). Counter-service and budget-friendly.
meals.dinner: The BOATHOUSE at Disney Springs – upscale-casual waterfront dining with fresh seafood, steaks, and classic American fare (~$30–$50 per person). A mid-range splurge for a special evening. Alternatively, Rainforest Cafe for a more family-friendly, themed experience (~$18–$28 per person).

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is free to enter and a great way to enjoy Disney magic without a park ticket. Parking is also free. Saturday can be busy — arrive by early afternoon. This is a great day to purchase any last-minute souvenirs or gifts.

day_by_day.morning: Return to a Favorite Park or Flex Day – Based on the family's energy and any missed must-dos, choose one park for a half-day visit. Recommended: Return to Magic Kingdom for any missed rides or to re-experience favorites, or revisit EPCOT's Future World attractions. Alternatively, use this morning for a final hotel pool session and packing.
day_by_day.afternoon: Check out of the Ramada by Wyndham Kissimmee Gateway (standard checkout ~11:00 AM — confirm with hotel). Store luggage at the front desk if needed. Spend the early afternoon at Disney Springs for any final shopping or a farewell meal. Arrange rideshare or shuttle to Orlando International Airport with plenty of time (~2–3 hours before departure).
day_by_day.evening: Depart from Orlando International Airport. Reflect on an incredible week at Walt Disney World! If the flight is late evening, enjoy a final meal at the airport's dining options (The Bubbalou's Bodacious Bar-B-Que or Chick-fil-A in the terminal).

meals.breakfast: Final hotel breakfast or a quick stop at a nearby Starbucks or Panera Bread on W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy.
meals.lunch: Lunch at Disney Springs (if doing a final visit) – Chicken Guy! by Guy Fieri for fun, affordable chicken tenders and sandwiches (~$12–$15 per person), or grab a quick bite at Earl of Sandwich.
meals.dinner: Airport dining or an early dinner near Disney Springs before heading to the airport.

day_by_day.notes: Allow extra time for checkout, luggage, and airport security on departure day. Orlando International Airport (MCO) is large — arrive at least 2.5–3 hours before your flight. Consider purchasing any forgotten souvenirs at the airport's Disney store in the terminal. Keep park tickets/MagicBands as keepsakes!

Confirm your hotel check-in is set for late arrival. Lay out park tickets, MagicBands, and the next day's outfits tonight to maximize efficiency tomorrow. Download the My Disney Experience app if not already done.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day – Begin with an early morning arrival via the hotel's free theme park shuttle (depart by 8:00 AM to catch rope drop at 9:00 AM). Head straight to Tomorrowland for Space Mountain using Lightning Lane Premier Pass, then move to Fantasyland for Seven Dwarfs Mine Train. Explore Peter Pan's Flight and 'it's a small world' before crowds build. Grab a Mickey-shaped waffle breakfast at The Plaza Restaurant or Crystal Palace for a character dining experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring Magic Kingdom — ride Pirates of the Caribbean, Haunted Mansion, and Big Thunder Mountain Railroad. Use Lightning Lane passes strategically to minimize wait times. Take a midday break at the hotel or a shaded area in Liberty Square to rest during peak heat hours (1:00–3:00 PM). Return refreshed for the afternoon and visit Adventureland and Frontierland. Don't miss the Festival of Fantasy Parade at 3:00 PM.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the iconic Happily Ever After fireworks spectacular at 9:00 PM — secure a premium viewing spot on Main Street U.S.A. near the hub at least 45 minutes early. Dine at Be Our Guest Restaurant (Beauty and the Beast themed, signature dining) for an unforgettable dinner inside Beast's Castle. Return to hotel via shuttle after fireworks.

meals.breakfast: Crystal Palace Character Breakfast (Winnie the Pooh characters) — reserve 60 days in advance via My Disney Experience.
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House (Liberty Square) for New England-style clam chowder and lobster rolls, or Skipper Canteen for a unique themed sit-down experience.
meals.dinner: Be Our Guest Restaurant — prix-fixe dinner menu featuring French-inspired cuisine in the grand ballroom of Beast's Castle. Reserve well in advance.

day_by_day.notes: Purchase Genie+ and Lightning Lane Premier Pass selections for Space Mountain and Seven Dwarfs Mine Train as soon as the park opens at 7:00 AM on the app. Wear comfortable, breathable clothing — June in Orlando is hot and humid (expect 90°F+). Bring a portable fan, sunscreen SPF 50+, and a refillable water bottle. MagicBands should be linked to your My Disney Experience account.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour – Take the hotel shuttle to EPCOT, arriving at rope drop (9:00 AM). Begin in Future World (now World Discovery and World Nature) — ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (Lightning Lane required) and Test Track. Head to World Nature for Soarin' Around the World for breathtaking aerial views. Grab a morning pastry and café au lait at the France Pavilion's Les Halles Boulangerie-Patisserie.
day_by_day.afternoon: Embark on a self-guided World Showcase Food & Culture Tour starting at 12:00 PM as the pavilions fully open. Sample authentic dishes and beverages across all 11 country pavilions: tacos and margaritas in Mexico, sushi and sake in Japan, fish and chips in the UK, crepes in France, and more. Visit the artisan shops and cultural exhibits in each pavilion. Ride Frozen Ever After in Norway and Remy's Ratatouille Adventure in France (Lightning Lane recommended).
day_by_day.evening: Conclude the evening with the spectacular EPCOT Forever or Harmonious nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon. Secure a lakeside table at a World Showcase restaurant for dinner with a view of the show. Return to hotel via shuttle.

meals.breakfast: Les Halles Boulangerie-Patisserie (France Pavilion) — croissants, pain au chocolat, and café au lait.
meals.lunch: Teppan Edo (Japan Pavilion) — premium teppanyaki-style dining with hibachi chefs performing tableside. Reserve in advance.
meals.dinner: Monsieur Paul (France Pavilion) — EPCOT's most upscale restaurant, offering classic French haute cuisine with panoramic lagoon views. Reserve 60 days in advance.

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT's World Showcase is a food lover's paradise — pace yourself across the pavilions and consider the EPCOT International Food & Wine Festival if visiting during that season (typically August–November). Wear comfortable walking shoes as EPCOT is one of Disney's largest parks. Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind requires a virtual queue or Lightning Lane — set an alarm for 7:00 AM to book.

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure – Take the hotel shuttle for an early arrival at Hollywood Studios (rope drop at 9:00 AM). Head immediately to Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge at Batuu. Book a time slot at Savi's Workshop to build a custom lightsaber — a deeply immersive, premium experience ($249.99 per lightsaber, reserve in advance). Explore the Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run attraction and browse the Black Spire Outpost marketplace for Star Wars merchandise and collectibles.
day_by_day.afternoon: After Galaxy's Edge, experience Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance (one of Disney's most technologically advanced rides — Lightning Lane Premier Pass essential). Transition to other Hollywood Studios highlights: Toy Story Land for Slinky Dog Dash and Alien Swirling Saucers, then The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster Starring Aerosmith. Catch the Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular show (check schedule).
day_by_day.evening: Experience the Fantasmic! nighttime spectacular — a water, fire, and projection show featuring Mickey Mouse. Arrive 45–60 minutes early for premium seating. Dine at Hollywood Brown Derby (signature dining, classic Hollywood glamour) for an elegant dinner. Return to hotel via shuttle.

meals.breakfast: Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo (Galaxy's Edge) — themed breakfast items like Ronto Morning Wraps in the Star Wars universe.
meals.lunch: Oga's Cantina (Galaxy's Edge) — the iconic Star Wars bar serving unique themed cocktails, mocktails, and light bites. Reservations required and highly competitive.
meals.dinner: Hollywood Brown Derby — signature restaurant inspired by the original Hollywood landmark, known for the Cobb Salad and premium steaks. Reserve 60 days in advance.

day_by_day.notes: Savi's Workshop reservations open 60 days in advance and sell out extremely fast — book the moment your window opens. Droid Depot (build a custom droid, ~$119.99) is another premium Galaxy's Edge experience if budget allows. Oga's Cantina has a 45-minute time limit per visit and reservations are mandatory. Check the My Disney Experience app for show times for Fantasmic! as schedules vary.

day_by_day.morning: Animal Kingdom Kilimanjaro Safari & Avatar Flight of Passage – Take the hotel shuttle to Animal Kingdom for rope drop (8:00 AM, one of the earliest opening parks). Head directly to Pandora – The World of Avatar for Avatar: Flight of Passage (Lightning Lane Premier Pass essential — this is the most in-demand ride at Disney World). The immersive banshee-riding experience is breathtaking. Follow with Na'vi River Journey for a serene boat ride through bioluminescent rainforest.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to Africa for the Kilimanjaro Safari — book an early afternoon slot for optimal wildlife activity. Spot lions, elephants, giraffes, rhinos, hippos, and zebras in a realistic savanna setting. Explore the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail on foot. Visit Asia for Expedition Everest (Lightning Lane recommended) and Kali River Rapids (prepare to get wet — bring a change of clothes or a poncho). Catch the Festival of the Lion King show in Africa — a spectacular Broadway-caliber live performance.
day_by_day.evening: Experience the Rivers of Light nighttime spectacular (check schedule availability). Dine at Tiffins Restaurant — Animal Kingdom's most prestigious signature dining experience, featuring globally inspired cuisine and stunning artwork. Return to hotel via shuttle for a relaxing evening.

meals.breakfast: Satu'li Canteen (Pandora) — healthy, globally inspired breakfast bowls in a stunning Avatar-themed setting.
meals.lunch: Yak & Yeti Restaurant (Asia) — pan-Asian cuisine including Kobe beef burgers, ahi tuna nachos, and dim sum in a richly decorated two-story restaurant.
meals.dinner: Tiffins Restaurant — Animal Kingdom's signature fine dining restaurant with a menu inspired by the travels of Disney Imagineers. Features premium seafood, game meats, and an extensive wine list. Reserve 60 days in advance.

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom is the most nature-immersive Disney park — bring insect repellent in addition to sunscreen. The park is also the most walking-intensive, so wear your most comfortable shoes. Avatar: Flight of Passage has a height requirement of 44 inches. Kilimanjaro Safari is best experienced in the morning or late afternoon when animals are most active — avoid midday heat slots. The park typically closes earlier than other Disney parks, so plan accordingly.

day_by_day.morning: Disney Springs Family Entertainment Day – Take a leisurely morning with a late start (no rush today). Sleep in, enjoy a relaxed hotel breakfast, and head to Disney Springs by 10:30–11:00 AM. Explore the free entertainment district — browse The LEGO Store (largest in the world), World of Disney (flagship Disney merchandise store), and unique boutiques. Watch street performers and live music acts throughout the day. Visit the NBA Experience for interactive basketball activities.
day_by_day.afternoon: Enjoy a premium shopping and entertainment afternoon at Disney Springs. Visit the Coca-Cola Store rooftop for complimentary beverage tastings with panoramic views. Explore Art of Disney gallery for collectible artwork and animation cels. If traveling with children, visit the LEGO Imagination Center. Consider a relaxing boat rental on the springs waterway. Browse the AMC Disney Springs 24 for a movie if a midday break is needed. Visit Splitsville Luxury Lanes for premium bowling and entertainment.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a spectacular dinner at one of Disney Springs' premium restaurants, then take in the vibrant evening atmosphere with live music, illuminated waterways, and entertainment. This is a great evening for souvenir shopping and a more relaxed pace before the final park day tomorrow. Return to hotel at leisure.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast — request a premium spread or visit a nearby local café for a relaxed start.
meals.lunch: The BOATHOUSE — Disney Springs' premier waterfront restaurant featuring prime steaks, fresh seafood, and classic American fare. Dine on the outdoor terrace overlooking the water. Amphibicar tours available.
meals.dinner: Morimoto Asia — Iron Chef Masaharu Morimoto's flagship pan-Asian restaurant featuring whole Peking duck, sushi, dim sum, and innovative Asian-fusion cuisine in a stunning two-story space.

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is free to enter and park — no theme park ticket required. This day serves as a natural recovery day from the intense park days. Splitsville Luxury Lanes requires a reservation on weekends. The BOATHOUSE offers unique Amphicar tours (vintage amphibious vehicles that drive into the water) — book in advance as they are very popular. This is an ideal day for premium souvenir shopping and picking up any last-minute gifts.

day_by_day.morning: Return to Magic Kingdom or EPCOT for a final half-day — choose based on any rides or experiences missed earlier in the trip. Alternatively, revisit a favorite park for a nostalgic farewell morning. Arrive at rope drop for maximum time. Focus on any Lightning Lane experiences not yet completed, or simply enjoy a leisurely stroll through your favorite areas. Pick up any final souvenirs from the park's premium shops (World of Disney at Magic Kingdom entrance, or MouseGear at EPCOT).
day_by_day.afternoon: Depart the park by early afternoon (12:00–1:00 PM) to allow time for hotel checkout, luggage collection, and transfer to the airport. If checkout is flexible, enjoy a final poolside hour at the hotel. Arrange private car transfer or use hotel shuttle to Orlando International Airport. Allow at least 3 hours before any departure flight for international or 2.5 hours for domestic, accounting for Orlando traffic on a Sunday.
day_by_day.evening: Depart Orlando with magical memories. If the flight is late evening, consider a final dinner near the airport or at the hotel before checkout.

meals.breakfast: Cinderella's Royal Table (Magic Kingdom, inside Cinderella Castle) — the ultimate Disney dining experience with character meet-and-greets and castle views. Reserve 60 days in advance. OR, if revisiting EPCOT, Garden Grill Restaurant for a character breakfast with Chip 'n' Dale.
meals.lunch: Quick-service farewell meal at your chosen park — Columbia Harbour House (Magic Kingdom) or Sunshine Seasons (EPCOT) for a lighter, faster option before departure.
meals.dinner: Airport dining at Orlando International Airport (MCO) — Kona Grill or Vino Volo wine bar for a premium pre-flight meal, or enjoy a final Florida meal at a nearby restaurant if time permits.

day_by_day.notes: Confirm hotel checkout time in advance — request a late checkout (1:00–2:00 PM) if available to maximize your final morning. Store luggage with the hotel concierge while you enjoy your last park hours. Ensure all MagicBands, Lightning Lane passes, and dining reservations are settled. Download or screenshot all photos from Disney PhotoPass before leaving — consider purchasing Memory Maker for unlimited digital downloads of all professional Disney photos taken throughout the trip ($199, best purchased before arrival for a discount).

query: Disney World Orlando family of 4, $6000, 7 days, June
